options.query:
SELECT "id", "full_name", "email", "phone", "job_title", "account_id", "owner_id", "status", "last_touch_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:contacts}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("full_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("job_title"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'full_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "full_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'full_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "full_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'job_title' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "job_title" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'job_title' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "job_title" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'last_touch_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "last_touch_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'last_touch_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "last_touch_at" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "full_name", "email", "phone", "job_title", "account_id", "owner_id", "status", "last_touch_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:contacts}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:contacts}} ("full_name", "email", "phone", "job_title", "account_id", "owner_id", "status", "last_touch_at", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::int, $6::int, $7::text, $8::timestamptz, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "full_name", "email", "phone", "job_title", "account_id", "owner_id", "status", "last_touch_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:contacts}}
SET "full_name" = $2::text, "email" = $3::text, "phone" = $4::text, "job_title" = $5::text, "account_id" = $6::int, "owner_id" = $7::int, "status" = $8::text, "last_touch_at" = $9::timestamptz, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "full_name", "email", "phone", "job_title", "account_id", "owner_id", "status", "last_touch_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:contacts}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:contacts}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:contacts}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
